name: Zoom-through transition

source.description: An inspected reel pushes the camera through a word on a tilted panel into the next space.

technique: The camera flies into an element (a letter counter, a window, a dot) until it passes the lens, and the next scene is found inside it.
purpose: Spatial continuity; 'going deeper' into a topic.
visual_behaviour: An element scales up rapidly with ease-in until its interior fills the frame; the next scene settles from slightly enlarged.
mechanics: Scale to 8-20x about an interior point with power3/expo.in; next scene from scale 1.15 to 1 with ease-out; brief overlap.
failure_modes: Scaling text to 20x blurs or costs raster time; switch at about 6x
Transform origin not on a hole or dark interior shows a flash

implementation.approach: Scale the outgoing scene about the target point (transformOrigin from Studio.boxAt), cut at cover, scale the incoming scene down from 1.15. The runtime now has Studio.fx.zoomThrough (Studio.transition type 'zoomThrough', src/studio/studio-motion.js); it has not yet been tested against this record. Variant seen in batch 1: zoom into a letter's stroke or a mark until its colour fills the frame, then use that colour as the next background.

provenance.observed: A push through a word on a tilted panel leads into a dark space with a metallic sphere.

The camera zooms through the counter of the 'O' in a serif word and the next layout is waiting inside it (9.8-10.1 s); at the end a zoom into a letter's stroke fills the frame with cream before the piece loops to its opening word (18.8-19.0 s).
The logo mark scales up past the lens until its dark stroke covers the frame, then clears to the next cream card (6.9-7.1 s).
The word 'zoom.' scales up about its full stop with an accelerating ease; letters leave the frame and the dot fills it in 0.33 s (3.62-3.95 s).
A push into a framed print on a wall until its picture fills the frame (25.46-25.69 s).
The camera flies through the O's counter into chrome rings in 0.35 s (2.18-2.52 s), the letters smearing past the lens.
The camera pushes into the chart until one candle and its price tag fill the frame (11.5-13.8 s) and continues into a macro scene of the candles (13.8 s).
The camera blur-zooms into the orange ball until orange fills the frame (10.12-10.32 s), then cuts to a dark frame where a dot blooms into particles.
The camera rushes into the O of a repeated word and its blue counter becomes the next background (11.03-11.23 s).
Zoom into a letter until its black bowl fills the frame (10.59-10.72 s), then red with a dot that grows into a sun.
